held_back.jaymoskingdoms.fine.0: Enough! Up you get. You'll pay for that blow, and that's the end of it.
held_back.jaymoskingdoms.fine.1: Put it away, all of you. The law settles this, not a blade.
held_back.jaymoskingdoms.fine.2: We're not butchers here. Pay the fine and mind your aim.
held_back.jaymoskingdoms.warning.0: Not a coin on you? Then get up and count yourself lucky.
held_back.jaymoskingdoms.warning.1: Back off, the lot of you. This one's had their lesson.
held_back.jaymoskingdoms.warning.2: On your feet. Strike one of ours again and it'll be the cells.
held_back.jaymoskingdoms.cells.0: Up. You'll cool off in the cells, not in the ground.
held_back.jaymoskingdoms.cells.1: Stand down, all of you. This one goes below.
held_back.jaymoskingdoms.cells.2: A night's thinking in the cells. That's the law here.
message.jaymoskingdoms.held_back.fined: %s's guard takes you in: you're fined %s for the blow, and the fight's called off.
message.jaymoskingdoms.held_back.warned: %s's guard takes you in: you can't pay the fine, so you're let off with a warning.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.107: A town's people keep each other honest: with others watching, its guards take a downed troublemaker to the cells (or fine them) instead of cutting them down. Only a hothead alone would kill an enemy of the town.
message.jaymoskingdoms.held_back.jailed: %s's guard takes you in for the blow: you're locked in the cells for %s minutes, and the fight's called off.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hard.cell.open: The cell door stands open. The jailer's stair beyond it climbs to a hatch in town: mind who's watching when you come up.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.112: A picked or opened cell door is walked out of: the passage beyond climbs to a hatch in town. Break out and you're hunted to be taken back, not shot on sight.
